rows.en: Sisk: "Oh! It looks like the Agarthian army has deployed."
Miyasco: "I'll put the footage on the monitor."
Fain: "Zaxas! Then that means my master!"
Ymir: "Deploying the Royal Knights means
they intend to settle this in one stroke."
Fain: "If my master is in command,
Zigrim will be crushed in an instant! It will be child's play!"
Miyasco: "Oh, that flag... Lieutenant Colonel Selg's unit..."
Sisk: "Then the commander is that muscle-brained idiot?!"
Ymir: "Sisk, calling him an idiot is going too far."
Sisk: "Okaaay."
Arthur: "More importantly, what happened with Gaiozon's signature?"
Sisk: "Well... I tried all sorts of things,
but it vanished suddenly, just like Rayode last time,
and that was the last of it."
Ymir: "Given the way it appeared earlier,
I can only think it's jumping through space..."
Leone: "Can even Ze=Ode do that?
A spatial jump is amazing technology, right? Not that I know much about it."
Arthur: "...Just how much do you know?"
Leone: "Huh?! How much...?
I'm just an ordinary law-abiding citizen, so... J-just the name, maybe?"
Clovis: "Then why was that ordinary citizen arranging to meet
Chairman Rakbal's secretary?"
Leone: "Th-that's..."
Xiujian: "What's wrong? You are a law-abiding citizen, aren't you?"
Leone: "I-I am, but...
Wh-what is this, an interrogation?! What have I done?!"
Arthur: "That isn't our intention. But..."
Kasumi: "Um... I don't think we should force her to answer
if she doesn't want to talk about it..."
Ai: "That's right! Girls have all sorts of things going on!
Aren't you being a little insensitive?"
Arthur: "...Then let me ask a different question.
Where is your home?"
Leone: "Well..."
Arthur: "You can't just keep traveling with us, after all.
We'll drop you off nearby. Right, Ymir?"
Ymir: "Huh?! Y-yes..."
Leone: "...Am I really that much of a nuisance...?"
Clovis: "H-hey, don't cry.
That's against the rules."
Leone: "...I... I'm looking for my father..."
Fain: "Huh?"
Leone: "He's been missing for a long time... So when I heard
Touya was aboard the Liebhofen, I came along.
I thought this ship would travel to all sorts of places..."
Kasumi: "And you thought you might find a lead on your father someday?"
Leone: "...Yeah. Please, can't I stay?"
Touya: "D-don't look at me..."
Leone: "..."
All right! You want me to ask for you, right?!
No.
Leone: "Don't be so mean...
Come on, it's okay, isn't it? Please?"
Oh, all right...
No means no.
Leone: "What's with you?! You could at least ask for me!
Fine, forget it! You cheapskate! Bleeeh!"
Touya: "Oh..."
Arthur: "She doesn't seem like a bad person,
but some of her words and actions are difficult to explain.
I think this was for the best."
Miyasco: "Then I'll use the guide lights to show her to the exit."
Kasumi: "...She's gone."
Ai: "We could've let her stay aboard..."
Leone: "Yay! I knew you were a nice guy!"
Touya: "Hey, stop it! Don't hug me!"
Leone: "But I'm happy!"
Touya: "That's no excuse! Just let go!"
Leone: "Heh heh. You're blushing. How cute!♥"
Kasumi: "..."
Ymir: "But... The fighting will probably only get harder.
Won't it be dangerous?"
Arthur: "I can't recommend it either.
Staying here is no guarantee
that she'll find her father.
She's more likely to be caught up in danger."
Touya: "That's what everyone thinks, but I'd like to follow
the captain's decision. Is that all right?"
Captain Roa: "Mm."
Sisk: "Oh, so that's your move!"
Touya: "This isn't a warship, so I don't think we have
any stiff regulations or anything..."
Captain Roa: "...Mm."
Touya: "We already have people aboard who aren't soldiers,
so there's no problem with letting her stay, right?"
Captain Roa: "...M-mm."
Touya: "...There you have it."
Ai: "That's playing dirty..."
Ymir: "Are you really sure?"
Captain Roa: "Mmm."
Ymir: "I see. If that's what the captain says..."
Miyasco: "I've wondered this for a while. How do they manage
to have a conversation with such short replies?"
Sisk: "...An eternal mystery."
Render: "The time has finally come."
??: "Yes. The promised day is near.
With the revival of our new leader, Dr. Bafred Debish,
this world will be reborn."
Render: "According to that girl's message,
one of Ze=Ode will soon arrive in this capital.
How should we coordinate with them?"
??: "There is no need to concern yourself with that.
First, we must secure this capital
for the Doctor's revival.
Fortunately, only a small minority in Agarthia
are concerned about Zigrim's invasion.
They will undoubtedly lose the opening battle."
Render: "And that will be our opportunity..."
??: "From this point on, I will take command of everything.
Will you all follow me?"
Render: "Of course."
Goh: "To fulfill our long-cherished wish."
Resh: "For our friend."
Ryord: "O-of course!"
Kinari: "..."
??: "Kinari, is there something you wish to say?"
Kinari: "Lord Ioannis is not here.
Is it all right for us to proceed on our own?"
Resh: "That bastard was never any use to us anyway."
Kinari: "B-but..."
??: "Ioannis refused to come here of his own free will.
In that case, there is nothing we can do for him.
Or are you saying that he alone is more important?"
Kinari: "N-no... Understood.
I entrust my life to you."
??: "Good. Then..."
Resh: "U-um, what about the boss lady...?"
??: "Ah, I have left her to eliminate the Spirit Mech pilots.
She will join us afterward."
Resh: "I-I see..."
??: "Resh. Would you concentrate on what is before you for now?
I expect great things of you,
and I'm sure Barkin does too."
Resh: "...Yes."
??: "Our control over the assembly is already nearly complete.
In the end, they cling to their seats
only for their own selfish desires.
Dangle some bait, and they wag their tails at once."
Resh: "Do you really trust those people,
who are worth less than garbage?"
??: "I do not trust them. Those who betray others for profit
will betray again for greater profit.
Once this is over, Resh, I will leave their disposal to you."
Resh: "Y-yes!"
??: "Now, I have prepared new Armored Mechs
for you this time."
Render: "From Bio?"
??: "Yes. They were somewhat costly, but their performance is assured.
I want you to make full use of them.
There is still a little time before the operation begins.
Until then, take particular care to avoid any rash actions.
Now, I wish you success."
Bio: "...This machine was originally meant for a certain other person.
But how could I refuse
a request from Lord Reidman? Please, take it.
And as for the fee..."
Ioannis: "Send the bill to the usual place.
Charge whatever you like."
Bio: "Yes, sir. Thank you as always..."
Ioannis: "Then I'll take it."
Celea: "...Is that all right?"
Bio: "This is business too.
I give it to the customer willing to pay more.
Perfectly natural, wouldn't you say?"
Celea: "...Even if the machine is unfinished?"
Bio: "It merely has some weapons that cannot be used properly.
It makes no difference whether they're there or not.
Besides, the buyer knows that and has agreed to the purchase.
There is no reason for me to refuse."
Celea: "Heh heh heh. What a frightening man.
But that is another thing I find attractive about you..."
Bio: "Heh..."
Touya: "...So, what do we do now?"
Ymir: "Zeulear was damaged in that battle,
and the engines need readjusting, so I was thinking
we should return to the Holy Land."
Yamato: "Then the engine's working
for nyow, at least?"
Ymir: "Yes. But they don't know
when it might start acting up again."
Xiujian: "Then there is no reason to hesitate."
Captain Roa: "Mm."
Baren: "...Course set. Liebhofen, launching."
Sisk: "Huh? Baren, you understand the captain?"
Baren: "...Mm. A little."
Miyasco: "Will we understand him eventually too... I wonder?"
Sisk: "Who knows?"
Ivel: "...Another of Ze=Ode has appeared?"
Ymir: "Yes. They seem capable of spatial jumps,
making pursuit almost impossible. It seems we can only
react after they move..."
Emy: "Big Sisteeer!"
Fain: "...You again."
Emy: "Oh, you're still alive."
Fain: "You're as rude as ever."
Emy: "Bleeeh!"
Fain: "Hmph. Ymir the Second."
Emy: "Hey! You said it again! Grrr!"
Ymir: "N-now, now.
Both of you, Emy, Fain..."
Ivel: "Emy, what became of that investigation?"
Emy: "Huh? Oh, you mean Daifozon?
You needn't worry.
The excavation is complete, and restoration is now underway."
Touya: "Daifozon?"
Emy: "Rayblade's original weapon, the Divine Sword Daifozon.
Unlike Rayblade, it was severely damaged,
and restoration work is in progress."
Ai: "Is that 'Divine Sword Whatever' any good?"
Emy: "It is the 'Divine Sword Daifozon.'
At the very least, it should be more powerful than any Spirit Mech's weapon.
Apparently..."
Touya: "An alarm?!"
Ivel: "This is..."
Emy: "Um... The Prana readings are Armored Mech class.
But... Their affiliation is unknown!"
Celica: "Unknown? Isn't the Holy Land's databank
linked to every country's main computer?"
Ivel: "Yes. If a machine is officially registered,
we should recognize it, even if it is an unannounced, state-of-the-art model."
Celica: "...Then a private mercenary group is the most likely explanation.
But a unit with that sort of funding..."
Gabon: "...Venir from Limberg,
or the independent Solitary Silver Wings."
Clovis: "Oh, old man, you know that side of things?
You don't look the type."
Ymir: "Gabon took part in the great war thirty-three years ago.
I was taught it was the last war
to engulf all of Agarthia."
Gabon: "More or less.
Now, about the mercenaries. I hear Venir's captain and deputy left
five years ago, and it's only a shell now. That leaves..."
Derock: "The Solitary Silver Wings, you know."
Gabon: "Don't steal my line!
Want another round of liposuction without anesthetic?"
Derock: "Eee! A-anything but that!
P-please forgive me, you know. I-I was wrong, you know.
P-Princess Celica, please save me, you know..."
Celica: "Wouldn't that be perfect?
Why don't you have him do it?"
Derock: "Nooo! That's cruel, you know.
You're so nasty, enjoying picking on me like that, you know.
Keep doing that and... *mutter, mutter*..."
Celica: "...So, what are these Solitary Silver Wings?"
Gabon: "O-oh, right. Well, they're generally known as a notorious
mercenary group that'll take any job for any country,
as long as the money's there. But their ability is the real thing.
Their captain in particular is rumored to have what it takes
to command an entire nation's army."
Touya: "If it's them..."
Touya: "The Solitary Silver Wings... Are those the guys
who showed up before?!"
Gabon: "Yeah. But it doesn't look like they're after us."
Touya: "Then that means..."
Xiujian: "Zigrim is their employer. The Holy Land is their target."
Ymir: "But Zigrim's troops are still near the border, aren't they?
Even if the mercenaries take the place, the Agarthian army will arrive at once."
Arthur: "There must be a reason why that would not matter.
Some objective other than occupation."
Touya: "Anyway, we can't let them have this place, right?!"
Gabon: "Right. Look, here they come."
Touya: "Everyone, let's go!"
Bart: "Oh, Touya..."
Touya: "Sorry, we'll talk later..."
Bart: "...Here."
Yamato: "Oh! That's your shirt, Touya!"
Touya: "Where the heck did you get something like this...?"
Bart: "Trade secret... Heh."
Touya: "W-well, thanks."
Bart: "Don't mention it. It's on the house."
Touya: "Wearing this really does feel right.
Well, I'm off."

review_batches.context: Agarthian deployment/Gaiozon discussion leads to questions about Leone, her missing-father account and multiple choices to let her stay or refuse. All 274 source rows examined, including the separate conspiracy and Holy Land scenes.
review_batches.decisions: Keep military versus spatial-jump hypotheses, Selg's actual command versus Fain's hoped-for master, Leone's account as her words, and every player-choice row/branch. Restore the direction of asking the captain and permit/no-permit choices. Preserve heart, speech interruptions, source continuations and incomplete thoughts without shortening for fit.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o000a6.l00: Fain sees Zaxas and expects his master to lead; the unit flag then identifies Selg as commander. Keep Fain's mistaken inference rather than correcting it early.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00254.l01: Spatial jumping is Ymir's explanation of the disappearance/appearance, not a demonstrated account of the mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00321.l01: Leone claims to know only the name as an ordinary citizen; preserve her evasion and the group's challenge about Doris without endorsing it as fact.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00548.l00: Arthur proposes dropping Leone off because he does not want indefinite travel aboard; it is not a command for her to pilot a mech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o005ff.l00: Missing-father explanation remains Leone's account. Do not name the father or confirm the stated motive from external plot knowledge.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00736.l00: Player agrees to ask permission on Leone's behalf, not to ask her for help. Preserve both initial and repeated refusal choices.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o007c5.l01: The rejection branch ends with Leone's insult and departure. Do not combine it with the subsequent accepting/hugging branch.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00872.l00: Guide lights direct her to the exit; no alarm, restraint or evacuation is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o0099b.l00: Heart cue retained for native font work; blushing is Leone's teasing description, not a new explicit relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00a92.l00: Touya proposes following the captain's decision, then uses leading questions and the captain's Mm replies. Preserve the comic manipulation, not an invented long speech from Roa.

review_batches.context: Touya uses Roa's short replies to support Leone staying; concealed leader directs terrorists, then Bio sells an unfinished machine to Ioannis. All 274 rows examined and compared with profiles for Barkin/Emy/Ioannis.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve anonymous leader, unexplained girl's message, pressure on Kinari, assembly corruption claims, disposal threat and Bio's profit motive. Boss lady is not identified as Barkin, whose profile identifies him separately as male. Keep every speech/row boundary and deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00ced.l00: Two-question-mark leader remains concealed throughout this scene; later Bio/Ioannis scene does not automatically reveal this voice's identity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00da9.l05: Opening defeat is the concealed leader's confident prediction; no battle outcome is narrated here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00e97.l00: Purpose-only pledge intentionally retains the source fragment in answer to the leader's question; following is supplied by that question.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00eb4.l00: For our friend is an intentional dedication-only answer to the collective pledge, not an omitted English subject in ordinary narration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00f2b.l00: Ioannis's absence and refusal are discussed as decisions; no death or incapacity is asserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o00ffd.l01: Kinari entrusts his life to the leader after pressure. Preserve the direction of allegiance and the leader's coercive comparison.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o0105e.l00: Boss lady translates the familiar female underworld address anesan without identifying her. Barkin is a separate male member in the library and must not be merged into this woman.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01079.l00: Eliminate the Spirit Mech pilots preserves the threat to dispose of people. Do not soften it into a harmless meeting.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01140.l00: Leader claims assembly control through baiting self-interested members. Treat it as that speaker's claim, not omniscient proof of each individual member's corruption.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o011db.l02: Their disposal remains a threat delegated to Resh after the operation. No completed killing or disposal method is added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01355.l00: Bio redirects a machine meant for someone else to Ioannis/ Lord Reidman for profit. These are source surname/given-name forms of the same glossary person, not separate buyers.

review_batches.context: Bio/Celea's deal aftermath, damaged Zeulear/engine return to Holy Land, Emy/Fain nickname quarrel, Daifozon restoration and unknown mercenary identification. Read all 274 rows plus relevant Emy library profile.
review_batches.decisions: Use Zeulear/Daifozon and group names from glossary. Expand Fain's shortened the Second taunt to the profile-confirmed Ymir the Second, not a family/nepotism claim. Keep excavation complete versus restoration ongoing, expected weapon strength, databank limitations and exact thirty-three/five-year references. Source omissions, interruptions and continuation rows remain deliberate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o014d6.l00: The unfinished machine has weapons that cannot be used properly; no exact weapon or technical cause is supplied. Bio says the buyer accepts the condition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o015fc.l00: Zeulear is the sword, not an additional mech. Engine readjustment is a separate reason to return to the Holy Land.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01723.l00: Baren mirrors Roa's Mm before saying a little. Preserve the understated joke about understanding the captain.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01873.l00: Big Sister is Emy's affectionate address to Ymir, as the library explains; no biological sister relationship is asserted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01924.l00: The shortened nisei taunt refers to the library's Ymir the Second nickname, earned from talent/personality comparisons. It is not a claim that Emy is Ymir's daughter or inherits office from a parent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o019c3.l02: Excavation is complete but restoration is ongoing. Do not present Daifozon as already combat-ready.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01aa3.l01: Should be stronger than any Spirit Mech weapon is Emy's expectation. Preserve that qualifier rather than inventing measured stats.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01b2d.l00: Armored Mech class refers to Prana readings; it is not a precise count, model or verified employer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01baf.l00: Databank recognition applies to officially registered machines, including unreleased designs. Do not say it identifies every secret or unregistered unit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01cd9.l00: Gabon fought thirty-three years ago; Ymir reports what she learned about that war's scope. Preserve both the count and reported historical context.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01d2c.l01: Venir lost its captain/deputy five years ago and is reportedly a shell, not definitively dissolved or destroyed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01db2.l01: Keep Gabon's explicit threat of another liposuction without anesthetic as a fictional character threat; no medical instruction or actual procedure is described.

review_batches.context: Gabon explains Solitary Silver Wings' reputation; alternate recognition paths lead to defending the Holy Land; Bart returns Touya's shirt. Final 34 rows; all 274 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve mercenaries' ability/reputation as reported, different possible objective from occupation, Zigrim-employer inference and shirt trade-secret joke without inventing a repair method. Retain Derock's muttering and all source fragments/physical boundaries.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01ede.l03: Captain's ability to command a nation's army is a reputation, not a current military office or a newly named person.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o01f67.l00: Alternate recognition branches: one asks what if these are the mercenaries, another recognizes the prior group. Keep both source blocks without fusing their knowledge states.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o0200e.l00: Xiujian identifies likely employer/target from the situation; Arthur then suggests an objective other than occupation. Do not invent that objective.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00d.o021fa.l00: Trade secret withholds how Bart obtained the shirt. Do not invent cloning, repair, fabrication or recovery details.
